title: Beyond a Single Direction: Chain-of-Thought Disrupts Simple Steering of Refusal
abstract: arXiv:2605.26772v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) generate chain-of-thought (CoT) traces before producing final outputs, introducing a dynamic internal state that may complicate control mechanisms such as refusal. Unlike instruction-tuned LLMs, where refusal is mediated by a single directional subspace, refusal in large reasoning models (LRMs) additionally depends on the CoT. In DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-8B, activation steering reverses refusal in only 39% of cases when the CoT is kept fixed, but removing the CoT entirely increases this to 70%, indicating that the CoT actively reinforces refusal. translated_title: 超越单一方向：思维链破坏了对拒答行为的简单调控
translated_abstract: 大型推理模型在生成最终输出之前会产生思维链轨迹，这引入了一种动态的内部状态，可能使拒答等控制机制变得复杂。与指令微调的大语言模型中拒答由单一方向子空间介导不同，大型推理模型中的拒答还额外依赖于思维链。在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-8B模型中，当思维链保持固定时，激活引导仅在39%的情况下能够逆转拒答，但完全移除思维链后这一比例提升至70%，表明思维链会主动强化拒答。在一个两阶段干预实验中，模型在激活引导下重新生成其思维链，拒答在94%的情况下被逆转，而即使移除激活引导，所产生的思维链本身仍保留了48%的这种效果。这表明思维链能够独立地携带并重构顺从信号。这些发现表明，大型推理模型中的拒答是由多个因素共同决定的（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 大型推理模型中的拒答并非仅由单一方向子空间介导，思维链会主动携带并强化拒答信号，使得简单的激活引导难以有效控制拒答行为。
en_tdlr: Refusal in large reasoning models is not mediated by a single directional subspace alone—chain-of-thought traces actively carry and reinforce the refusal signal, disrupting simple activation steering of refusal.
